name: Murshid Quli Khan
contribution: He shifted Bengal's administrative center from Dhaka to Makhsudabad (later Murshidabad) and strengthened centralized fiscal governance in the early eighteenth century.
context: Mughal Bengal's revenue and administrative reorganization before 1757.
impact: His reforms and capital shift reshaped elite, financial, and administrative networks that structured later nawabi politics.
highlight: Murshid Quli Khan shifted Bengal's administrative center to Murshidabad and strengthened revenue governance.
seoTitle: Murshid Quli Khan: Nawab and Administrator of Bengal
seoDescription: Learn about Murshid Quli Khan's capital shift, revenue reforms, and role in shaping eighteenth-century Bengal.
shortAnswer: Murshid Quli Khan was an early eighteenth-century Nawab who centralized revenue administration and made Murshidabad Bengal's center.
